newsitem.title: POLAND: Bomb blast in Warsaw injures seven.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast in Warsaw injures seven.

text.p: A powerful bomb exploded in central Warsaw during the evening rush hour on Thursday night, injuring seven people, police said on Friday.
A police spokesman said it was not clear who planted the bomb, which appeared to have been packed with nails and made with military or mining explosives.
The country's criminal underworld has increasingly been using bombs in recent years to extort money from small firms or shops, remove business competition, or settle gangland scores.

Thursday's blast was near an open-air market close to the busiest intersection in the Polish capital. Some of the injured were taken to hospital for surgery to remove shrapnel, but no lives were in danger, the spokesman added.
The bombing brought the total number of such attacks in Warsaw this year to 12. No one has died in the blasts.
